meta.title: Third search sweep, batch 04: cross-check of quoted excerpts
meta.method: Each claim that is not a no_link finding and whose excerpt was found in the captured page text (or in the page reader's extract) was given, with the page text around the excerpt (about 700 characters on each side), to a checker told to try to refute it. Checkers judged only from that context, 25 claims at a time. The page text itself is not republished here.

verdict_values.supported: the context states this subject, relation, object, date and amount
verdict_values.partly_supported: the core holds but a detail is wrong or goes beyond the excerpt (see problems and corrected_claim)
verdict_values.not_supported: the context does not say this, or says something else
verdict_values.cannot_tell: the context around the excerpt is too short to judge

meta.label_check: label_ok says whether the label fits the claim as written; suggested_label gives the checker's label where it does not. Labels are not changed in the batch files.
meta.translation_check: translation_ok says whether evidence_translation is a faithful literal translation of evidence_text.
meta.context_source: page_text, page_text of a linked page the same reader opened, or reader_extract (the page reader's own extract; a verdict on it only says the claim matches that extract).
meta.not_checked: no_link findings, claims whose excerpt was not found in any captured text, and claims added after the check ran.
